CRM Bookmark Sync – Privacy Policy

Last updated: 9 October 2026

CRM Bookmark Sync is a Chrome extension for staff who use the CRM at crm.beontimeofficial.com or rudraverse.trinetratechnoworld.com. It copies the user's Chrome bookmarks into their organisation's CRM account. This page explains what the extension accesses and why.

What the extension accesses

  • Bookmarks – the title, URL and folder name of each bookmark, and Chrome's internal bookmark id. Pages starting with chrome:// or edge:// are skipped.
  • CRM login tokens – when the user clicks "Connect", the extension reads the login tokens the CRM has already stored in the browser for the open CRM tab. It reads nothing else from that tab or from any other website.

How the data is used

  • Bookmark data is sent only to the CRM backend (crm-backend.beontimeofficial.com) over HTTPS, and is stored in the user's organisation account. It is visible to other members of that organisation on the CRM's Bookmarks page.
  • The login tokens are kept in the extension's local Chrome storage on the user's own computer and are used only to authenticate requests to the CRM backend.
  • No data is sold, shared with third parties, used for advertising, or used for any purpose other than syncing bookmarks to the CRM.
  • The extension does not track browsing history and does not run on any website other than the CRM.

Removing your data

  • Bookmarks can be deleted at any time from the CRM's Bookmarks page. Deleting a bookmark in Chrome also removes it from the CRM while auto-sync is on.
  • Uninstalling the extension deletes the stored login tokens and settings from the browser.
  • To have all bookmark data removed from your organisation's CRM account, contact your CRM administrator.

Changes

If this policy changes, the updated version will be published at this address with a new date.
